title: SceneRequest
description: Input to POST /scene: a map location, crop radius, rotation, and optional preset selector.

radius_m.description: Half-width of the square crop, in meters, per the 01 radius handle range.

rotation_deg.description: Rotation applied to the crop about the origin before squaring, degrees.

preset_id.description: Optional id selecting a cached preset fixture instead of a live Overpass fetch.
